{{Quote|The troopers&mdash;why did they attack us?''"<br />"''I don't know.''"<br />"''Will they follow us, do you think?''"<br />"''I don't know.''"<br />"''Where will we go?''"<br />"''I don't know.|[[Chase Piru]] and [[K'Kruhk]], shortly after the massacre|<ref name="Dark Times 6" />}}
During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''massacre''' took place at the [[Bogden Jedi chapter house|Jedi chapter house]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Bogden 3]] when [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was enacted.
